positions.name: ReviewerEnrollmentProbe
positions.frame: what does saving a memory establish about reviewer enrollment, and what role does this memory itself play in asserting that?
positions.why: src-1 states the e2e suite's assertion that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer; src-2 explicitly refers back to 'that assertion' and frames the present memory as existing solely to carry it. The two are self-referentially bound — one names the claim, the other names the vehicle for the claim — a single directional read (probe-as-carrier of a behavioral assertion) spans both, with matching conviction (plain, unhedged claim) and matching temporal/power/value readings across both segments.
